svg.title: Sliding windows bound attention and the KV cache
svg.desc: Sliding-window attention lets each token attend only to the latest w positions, giving O(nw) cost and a rolling cache of size w. Stacked layers extend the theoretical receptive field to about Lw, though information can dilute; global tokens can add document-level access.

g.text: Sliding windows bound attention and the KV cache
Each token reads the latest w positions; stacked layers extend the theoretical receptive field.
Longformer adds a few global tokens for document-level access.
A fixed window limits cache memory but cannot recall evicted text.
